name: Draenor-Core Build & Runtime
description: WoW: Warlords of Draenor 6.2.3.20779 preservation baseline for EyalMK/Draenor-Core on modern Linux (GCC 13 / OpenSSL 3 / ACE 7.1.2). Server builds clean, Firestorm DBs imported, frFR client reaches world with movement. Phase 4 world playability and content fixes are current.
runCommand: podman exec draenor-devbox bash -lc 'cd /home/blizz/Draenor-Core/run-world && rm -f console.fifo && mkfifo console.fifo && exec 9<>console.fifo && exec ./worldserver < console.fifo >> worldserver-live.log 2>&1'
testCommand: podman exec draenor-devbox bash -lc 'ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,comm,args | grep "[.]\/worldserver" || true; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8085 || true; tail -40 /home/blizz/Draenor-Core/run-world/worldserver-live.log'

launchProfile.statusCommand: check() { if distrobox enter draenor-devbox -- bash -lc "ss -ltn | grep -q ':$2 '" 2>/dev/null; then echo "$1 up"; else echo "$1 down"; fi; }; check mariadb 3307; check authserver 1119; check worldserver 8085; if ss -lun 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':53 '; then echo 'dns up'; else echo 'dns down'; fi; if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':80 '; then echo 'ngdp-http up'; else echo 'ngdp-http down'; fi; if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':87 '; then echo 'auth-relay up'; else echo 'auth-relay down'; fi
